purpose: Two standalone concept images, not production texture components or WBP implementation
image_model: not exposed by the tool; no model identity inferred from the agent

attempts.prompt:
Generate ONE high-fidelity finished concept IMAGE of the ProjectM CHAT HUD redesign. Landscape 16:9, ideally 1920x1080. This is a close-up presentation of the lower-left portion of a game screen: one beautiful chat interface over a softly defocused sunlit HD-2D fantasy village with stone paving and green foliage. The chat occupies about 72% of the image width and 58% of its height, comfortably positioned lower-left with generous exterior margins so fine design details can be judged. No other menu windows, no concept-sheet annotations, no multiple variants. Maintain a plausible wide low HUD proportion, not a big messenger app.

Use supplied image 1 as the DIRECT primary visual reference, specifically its chat panel in the lower-left: precise clipped corners, warm fine continuous trim, top channel tabs, independent bottom input, calm blue surfaces. Image 2 supports contemporary polished fantasy styling and softer blue navy luminance. Keep their distinctive authored game-interface character and warm detailing. Improve the craft, hierarchy, whitespace and floating composition; do not simply copy or recolor the reference screenshot.

Design language: modern floating structure + restrained but identifiable fantasy shape language. Large surface is soft medium BLUE NAVY, visibly blue with perceptual luminance around #29465F / #35556E, NOT gray/graphite, black or a cream/light main panel. The broad message pane has subtle matte blue tonal depth and restrained transparency; believable hints of the game world show through without compromising text. Top tabs slightly lighter blue, bottom entry slightly deeper navy. Fine ivory outlines must be visibly continuous and refined at final size. Champagne gold is limited to the selected channel marker and one very small Naia tear / Arcadia diamond corner detail, not every border. No bevels, shiny metallic body, thick frame, glow, neon, rough noise or muddy gradient. This should look art-directed and premium rather than flat stock app UI.

Structure:
A long single message panel with disciplined shallow clipped corners, a small asymmetric corner cut at upper left and restrained complementary lower-right detail. One tiny consistent diamond-ended line detail supports its fantasy identity without large side ornaments.
A floating row of four distinct compact channel tabs sits slightly above the message surface: speech bubble + '일반', pin + '지역', globe + '월드', two-person icon + '파티'. Tabs align, icons have the same flat ivory stroke weight. '일반' is selected: slightly brighter blue tab, a short muted-gold lower edge and tiny diamond marker. Other tabs are readable quieter open silhouettes, not four gold-framed identical buttons. At far right of this row, compact left chevron, right chevron and plus controls. No generic web navigation bar.
An independent narrow input assembly below the panel with a small clear gap. At left a compact shaped channel selector labelled '지역' with a downward chevron; then a long deep-blue text-entry field with exact hint '메시지를 입력하세요. (Enter로 전송)'; at far right a small separate send button with flat ivory paper-plane icon. Shape and line weight match the top tabs and message panel.
Six readable sample messages, in tasteful Korean game typography, with strong legibility, comfortable line spacing and generous internal padding. Channel prefixes in restrained light muted blue, body text warm ivory, one muted champagne system line. Render exactly:
'[지역] 리베르: 마을 입구에서 만나요.'
'[일반] 미나: 새 퀘스트 확인했어요?'
'[파티] 루카: 준비되면 출발할게요.'
'[월드] 아리아: 함께 모험할 분을 찾습니다.'
'[일반] 미나: 좋아요, 곧 도착해요.'
'[시스템] 새로운 모험 기록이 추가되었습니다.'
Leave measured breathing room below the conversation. Tiny unobtrusive scroll thumb at the right edge. No timestamps, avatar cards, message bubbles, social-app sidebar, settings/modal, player portrait, giant emblem, or new unrelated colors.
This image represents only ChatRootOverlay, so do not depict a custom tab configuration modal. All controls must be fully in frame. The reference-inspired corner geometry, airy blue surface, warm precision lines and consistent tiny symbols are the visual focus.

visual_review.status: accepted as concept proposal, not user-approved production design
findings: One readable chat UI with tabs, messages and independent input controls.
Blue navy surfaces, clipped corners, warm fine trim and selected marker relate directly to supplied references.
No configuration modal, gray primary surface, crop or literal fantasy object.
limitations: Concept compositing and baked sample text are intentional; not directly usable as a runtime panel texture.

images.purpose: Quest journal and matching tracker improved design concept

attempts.prompt:
Create ONE polished production-quality concept IMAGE for the ProjectM quest journal UI, landscape 16:9, ideally 1920x1080. This is a composed game-interface concept, not a texture atlas, not a wireframe. Use the two supplied images as DIRECT VISUAL REFERENCES: reference 1 is the game's quest/chat visual language (distinctive clipped corners, precise cream outline, restrained champagne fittings, diamond-ended dividers, refined Korean typography); reference 2 supplies elegant modern composition and blue surface softness. Retain their authored fantasy-game identity and craft quality.

Apply this updated direction while redesigning: balanced Modern Structure + Stylized Fantasy Identity + Abstract Journal. Main surfaces must remain visibly BLUE soft mid navy and blue-navy, with differentiated luminance, NOT graphite/neutral gray, black, or large ivory/white/cream content panels. Use the perceived soft blue of the references' navy panels, preferably calm mid blue-navy around #29465F / #35556E; avoid dark opaque slabs and electric blue. Ivory is for readable text, precise thin warm outlines, small markers. Restrained muted champagne gold appears in only three roles: the small title emblem, selected-category marker, and reward detail. Finish is subtly matte with almost imperceptible surface variation; no metallic bevel or plastic gloss. Thin borders must nevertheless read clearly and continuously.

Compose a beautifully designed quest journal over a subdued sunlit HD-2D fantasy village with stone paths and green foliage, world visible at margins and between independent UI layers. Most image area goes to the interface. A slim compact quest tracker at upper left establishes its matching HUD family. Main journal is a generous asymmetrical group of independent flat floating cards at center/right: left narrow quest index, a larger independent right quest-record card, category tabs slightly projecting above them, a separate smaller reward card overlapping just below the record, and an independent small tracking action tag toward bottom right. No single frame connecting all cards, no book spine or physical pages. Header has a shaped cut corner and a small Naia tear enclosed by a simple Arcadia diamond; card corners use the same intentional shallow clipped geometry. Title and body have different silhouettes. Section lines terminate in tiny matching diamonds. Maintain generous spacing, clear visual hierarchy, crisp warm lines, purposeful small fantasy details in at least 3 places, but leave most edges and content unornamented. Do not create plain admin-app rectangles. No large watermark, giant magic diagram, all-gold frame, hinges, leather, page curl, bookshelf, monitor/browser frame, design annotations or extra concept variants.

Render a coherent fully populated readable Korean interface with exact short labels:
Main title '모험 기록서'.
Five floating categories '전체', '메인', '서브', '일일', '튜토리얼'. '메인' is selected, with small gold marker and brighter BLUE surface, other categories light open tabs, not identical gold-bordered buttons.
Left index sections '진행 중 1', '수락 가능 2', '완료한 기록'. Selected quest '뿌리 사이로', secondary quests '단힌 뿌리', '잊혀진 기록'. Only selected row receives a surface; other rows are calm text with tiny category markers.
Right detail title '뿌리 사이로'; small metadata '메인 퀘스트 · 권장 레벨 6'. Body heading '의뢰 내용', then '오랜 방황 끝에 숲 속 마을에 도착했다.' and '리베로그로브 아래 마을로 향하자.' Next section '목표', a small diamond objective icon, '아래 마을 입구에 도착하기', progress '0 / 1'.
Detached reward card '보상', two tiny refined reward icons and values '경험치 1,333' and '골드 300'.
Separate action tag '목표 추적'. Small close X aligned at the top right.
Compact matching tracker shows tiny orange quest exclamation (orange only there), '퀘스트', '뿌리 사이로', '아래 마을 입구에 도착하기'.
All UI must feel like a premium contemporary fantasy mobile RPG from the supplied reference family, with deliberate geometry and warm detail rather than a generic blue app. Prioritize refined full-screen composition, balanced negative space, consistent motifs and convincing finished design.
attempts.rejection_reason: Shared backing connects title and cards; large watermark/forest illustration overpower quiet record surface.

attempts.prompt:
Refine this ONE quest UI concept image. The FIRST supplied image is the edit target; SECOND is the original game art-direction reference. Keep the edit target's existing composition, all Korean content, sizes, village setting, blue navy/ivory palette, shaped tabs, precise clipped corners and polished typography. Make only a focused reduction of oversized framing/background decoration so the intended independent floating cards are unambiguous:
1. REMOVE the single shared blue backing and its enclosing outer border behind the title, category row and both columns. The title emblem and '모험 기록서' sit cleanly over a locally subdued village background, with the five category tabs independently floating above the right card. Preserve strong title contrast with restrained local darkening rather than a rectangular header bar. Clearly show narrow strips of the village in the gap between left index card and right record card and beneath the detached title area. Keep each card's own fine continuous ivory outline and clipped corner silhouette.
2. REMOVE the large compass watermark AND forest/castle illustration inside the right content surface. Its surface should be calm soft blue navy, with only subtle matte tonality. Preserve the section headings, short ivory dividers ending in tiny diamonds, and all text.
3. Gold accent concentration: keep muted champagne at the title emblem, selected '메인' category and a tiny reward corner. Convert gold on the repeated card corners, section markers, selected QUEST ROW outline and tracking-tag full perimeter to fine warm IVORY. Keep the brighter blue selected row. Keep warm-gold reward amounts. No loss of distinctive corner shapes or fine inner framing. The tracking action must remain an elegant separate shaped tag.
Everything else stays as close as possible to the first image. Do not convert any main surface to gray or cream. Do not add book parts, new decorations, extra windows, additional text or captions. Output ONE refined 16:9 final concept image.

visual_review.status: accepted as concept proposal with minor omissions, not user-approved production design
findings: Shared backing and large content illustration removed; village visible in the column gap.
Distinct index/record cards, projected category tabs, overlapping reward card and separate tracking tag.
Consistent clipped corner/divider motifs, blue navy primary surfaces, ivory information; no physical book or broad cream content.
limitations: Close X disappeared with the removed shared header; restore in any implementation. This concept is not an interaction-complete specification.
Some warm corner/section accents remain; refine Gold allocation during asset separation.
Concept contains baked text and background; production UI must use separate components.
